name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response pertains to the context of the conversation and the provided interesting fact.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and inventiveness of the response, including the use of unique ideas or perspectives.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and clarity of the response. Does it make sense and is it easy to follow?

name: Engagement
description: Measures how engaging the response is for the intended audience. Does it capture attention and provoke thought or discussion?

name: Depth
description: Assesses the level of insight or detail provided in the response. Does it explore the topic thoroughly?

name: Grammar and Style
description: Evaluates the grammatical correctness and stylistic quality of the response. Is it well-written and polished?
